observations: Photo 0 shows a used automotive gearbox with a large input shaft flange and a transmission housing.
Photo 1 shows the same gearbox from a slightly different angle, with a black rubber hose attached to the top.
Photo 2 shows the gearbox from a higher angle, revealing the input shaft flange and the surrounding workshop environment.
The gearbox appears to be a manual transmission with a metal input shaft flange.
There is a watermark 'GEARUP INC.' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' across all photos.
The item is located in a workshop or scrap yard environment with other engines and parts visible.

claims.evidence: No brand name is legible on the gearbox casing in any photo.
No Ford badge or model-specific markings are visible on the gearbox.
The gearbox itself does not show a 4-cylinder engine configuration; it is a transmission component.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or worn gears
risks.proof: A video of the gearbox being tested with a hand-held gear tester or a bench test.

risks.risk: Missing input shaft flange or damaged input shaft
risks.proof: A clear photo of the input shaft flange and the input shaft itself.
A photo of the output shaft flange.
A photo of the mounting brackets and the gasket area.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the gearbox being tested to confirm it is functional.
Clear photo of the input shaft flange.
Clear photo of the output shaft flange.
Photo of the mounting brackets and gaskets.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
